task.title: Access SMS web application
task.shortdesc: To access the SMS web application, you need to be added as an authorized user

context.p: To access the SMS web application, you need to be added as an authorized user by an admin. Once added, you will receive an invitation email with a Get Started link to create an account.
To access the SMS web application:

step.cmd: Check if you have received the invitation email from the ADI OtoSense™ admin.
Click the Get started link received in the email.
Enter your email address, first name, and last name.
Enter a password as per the OtoSense™ password policy and click SIGN UP.

info.p: The application sends a verification code to your email address.

step.cmd: Check if you have received the email with the verification code and enter the code.
Click VERIFY to activate your account.

result.p: Once your account is created, you will receive a Welcome email with a link to sign in to your account.
